name: Asanaga Shuuji
source:
“They might not make you bleed, but words can be deadly too, you know!”

A teenager that hates science. Our protagonist. Also a virgin.

His [url=/c61988]grandfather[/url] was the second Japanese physicist to be awarded a Nobel Prize. Shuuji and his childhood friend, [url=/c55333]Yotsuko[/url], have been mentored by him ever since they were young.

A science-loving boy, but the constant comparisons to his grandfather made him grow sick of it. One day, his grandfather went on a trip to England, only to end up going missing. Shuuji was in so much shock that he started writing music to escape reality.

And so he lived as a miserable virgin, until he was reunited with Yotsuko and they somehow ended up being flung through time. Shuuji now finds himself surrounded by four strange girls (and Yotsuko), and to make matters worse, he's the only one with a lick of common sense!

[Edited from [url=http://solpress.co/projects/newton/]English official site[/url]]
